landing.agentSystemDesc: Coordinate multi-step agent work, task handoffs, streaming output, and extensible agent types for real internal workflows.
landing.architectureDesc: Deploy a FastAPI + React workspace with LangGraph/deepagents execution, Redis/MongoDB persistence, sandbox isolation, and extension layers for MCP, Skills, memory, and model providers.
landing.channelsIntegrationsDesc: Bring governed agents into WeCom and other team channels with project binding, model selection, and notification workflows.
landing.coreFeaturesDesc: Give platform teams centralized control over models, tools, permissions, and operations while business teams use agents to deliver work.
landing.ctaDescription: Connect your models, MCP servers, Skills, and enterprise channels, then give teams a governed place to use AI in daily work.
landing.customSkillsMcpDesc: Package reusable workflows as Skills and connect MCP servers so agents can use approved internal tools and team standards.
landing.documentSupportDesc: Preview PDF, Word, Excel, PPT, Markdown, Mermaid, images, and generated files with cloud storage for business deliverables.
landing.feedbackSystemDesc: Collect thumbs ratings, comments, session-linked feedback, and run-level signals so platform teams can improve agent quality.
landing.footerTagline: Self-hosted AI Agent workspace for enterprise teams.
landing.frontendFeaturesDesc: A responsive, multilingual web workspace with dark/light themes, rich content rendering, and familiar chat interaction.
landing.heroDescription: Deploy a private AI Agent workspace for your enterprise. Govern models, MCP tools, Skills, permissions, and channels while business teams deliver reports, presentations, analysis, and workflow automation from web and WeCom.
landing.mainInterfaceDesc: A unified web entry point for streaming agent work, rich documents, files, shared sessions, and reusable workflows.
landing.managementPanelsDesc: Manage Agents, models, Skills, MCP servers, roles, feedback, settings, and shared sessions from one operational dashboard.
landing.mcpIntegrationDesc: Govern system and user MCP servers with encrypted secrets, dynamic caching, SSE/HTTP transports, import/export, and tool-level access control.
landing.modelManagementDesc: Centralize OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Kimi, and other providers with channel routing, role visibility, user defaults, and fallback models.
landing.observabilityDesc: Use tracing, structured logs, health checks, user management, and access controls to operate agents with confidence.
landing.realtimeStorageDesc: Keep long-running agent sessions live with Redis + MongoDB dual-write, WebSocket updates, auto reconnect, sharing, and project folders.
landing.responsiveDesignDesc: Review sessions, share results, and monitor agent work across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
landing.sandboxExecutionDesc: Run agent tasks inside isolated sandboxes (Daytona / E2B / OpenSandbox) with controlled execution, environment isolation, and safety.
landing.securityAuthDesc: Protect model and tool access with JWT, RBAC, OAuth, email verification, CAPTCHA, and sandbox execution boundaries.
landing.skillsSystemDesc: Manage reusable internal workflows with dual storage, access control, GitHub sync, marketplace publishing, batch operations, and authoring tools.
landing.taskManagementDesc: Operate long-running work with concurrency control, cancellation, heartbeat monitoring, and pub/sub notifications.
landing.webSearchDesc: Rich web search with domain filtering, time range filters, region support, and configurable content size control.

openSandboxAdmin.legacyHint: The original single-node OpenSandbox settings below are still in use. You can still inspect and act on managed sandboxes here; switch to multi-node before adding independent nodes.
openSandboxAdmin.removeNodeHint: Remove node (rejected while bindings or reservations exist)
openSandboxAdmin.forceRemoveHint: Force remove: clear local occupancy and delete the node immediately (no save required)
openSandboxAdmin.inventoryHint: Only sandboxes created by Kunxiaozhi with a binding are listed, not every container on the node.
openSandboxAdmin.inventoryHintLegacy: Managed inventory is hidden in single-node compatibility mode. Switch to multi-node to list bindings that already have node affinity.
openSandboxAdmin.freezeHint: Freeze: memory remains allocated and TTL continues
openSandboxAdmin.terminateWarning: This cannot be undone. Sandbox files will be permanently lost and an active task may be interrupted.
openSandboxAdmin.forgetLocalHint: Clear local ledger only (no remote call)
openSandboxAdmin.forgetLocalWarning: Local occupancy is cleared and this node's x/10 capacity drops immediately. The remote container may still exist and will be reclaimed when its OpenSandbox TTL expires. This cannot be undone.
openSandboxAdmin.removeWarning: Only unused nodes can be removed; the change takes effect after saving.
openSandboxAdmin.forceRemoveWarning: Local occupancy and the x/10 capacity are cleared. The remote container may still exist and will be reclaimed when its OpenSandbox TTL expires. If this is the last multi-node entry, the mode switches to single-node compatibility. This cannot be undone.

settingDesc.LOGIN_IDLE_TIMEOUT_HOURS: Idle session timeout after last real user activity (hours)
settingDesc.ADMIN_CONTACT_EMAIL: Administrator contact email displayed to users in the About dialog
settingDesc.ADMIN_CONTACT_URL: Administrator contact/support URL (e.g. help desk, feedback form) displayed to users in the About dialog
settingDesc.APP_BASE_URL: Public base URL for file download/upload URLs (e.g. https://kunxiaozhi.com). Required when behind a reverse proxy where request.base_url is incorrect.
settingDesc.ARQ_EMBEDDED_WORKER: Start an embedded arq worker inside each FastAPI process when TASK_BACKEND is arq.
settingDesc.ARQ_JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: Maximum runtime for one arq job in seconds.
settingDesc.ARQ_QUEUE_NAME: Redis queue name used by arq for 昆小智 task jobs.
settingDesc.ARQ_WORKER_MAX_JOBS: Maximum concurrent arq jobs per FastAPI process.
settingDesc.AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL_ID: Model card ID (kind=transcribe) used by the audio_transcribe tool. Reference a card whose value is a transcription model such as gpt-4o-mini-transcribe or FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall. Leave empty to disable the tool.
settingDesc.ANALYTICS_USAGE_HOURLY_ENABLED: Enable hourly pre-aggregation for token analytics; disabled by default.
settingDesc.ANALYTICS_USAGE_HOURLY_FLUSH_SECONDS: Flush interval for the live hourly usage aggregate (seconds, 30-3600).
settingDesc.ANALYTICS_USAGE_HOURLY_BACKFILL_INTERVAL: Interval between hourly-usage backfill passes over frozen daily snapshots (seconds, min 60).
settingDesc.ANALYTICS_USAGE_HOURLY_BACKFILL_BATCH_DA: Number of calendar days processed per historical snapshot backfill batch (minimum 1).
settingDesc.CHECKPOINT_BACKEND: Checkpoint storage backend. Use 'postgres' to avoid MongoDB's 16MB document size limit on long conversations.
settingDesc.CHECKPOINT_CLEANUP_BATCH_LIMIT: Maximum number of sessions cleaned per scan, to bound database load.
settingDesc.CHECKPOINT_CLEANUP_ENABLED: Periodically delete LangGraph checkpoints for long-inactive sessions to reclaim storage. Chat history and analytics are unaffected; a cleaned session can still be viewed and chatted with, but loses its earlier conversational context.
settingDesc.CHECKPOINT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_HOURS: How often the cleanup scan runs, in hours.
settingDesc.CHECKPOINT_CLEANUP_RETENTION_DAYS: Keep checkpoints for sessions active within this many days. Sessions with no activity for longer have their checkpoints deleted (minimum 7 days).
settingDesc.CHECKPOINT_PG_DB: PostgreSQL database for checkpoint storage. Leave empty to use POSTGRES_DB.
settingDesc.CHECKPOINT_PG_HOST: PostgreSQL host for checkpoint storage. Leave empty to use POSTGRES_HOST.
settingDesc.CHECKPOINT_PG_PASSWORD: PostgreSQL password for checkpoint storage. Leave empty to use POSTGRES_PASSWORD.
settingDesc.CHECKPOINT_PG_POOL_MAX_SIZE: Checkpoint PostgreSQL connection pool maximum size
settingDesc.CHECKPOINT_PG_POOL_MIN_SIZE: Checkpoint PostgreSQL connection pool minimum size
settingDesc.CHECKPOINT_PG_USER: PostgreSQL username for checkpoint storage. Leave empty to use POSTGRES_USER.
settingDesc.DAYTONA_AUTO_ARCHIVE_INTERVAL: Daytona sandbox auto-archive interval in minutes
settingDesc.DAYTONA_AUTO_DELETE_INTERVAL: Daytona sandbox auto-delete interval in minutes after being archived
settingDesc.DAYTONA_AUTO_STOP_INTERVAL: Daytona sandbox auto-stop interval in minutes
settingDesc.DAYTONA_IMAGE: Daytona sandbox image (snapshot) to use for creating sandboxes
settingDesc.DOCUMENT_PARSE_MAX_BYTES: Maximum download size in bytes for documents parsed by the read_document tool. Files exceeding this are rejected before being sent to MinerU.
settingDesc.DOCUMENT_PARSE_MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS: Maximum characters of Markdown returned by the read_document tool. Longer documents are truncated with a notice. Default 50000 (~12k tokens).
settingDesc.DEFAULT_AGENT: Default agent type for new sessions
settingDesc.DEFAULT_MODEL_ID: Admin default model configuration for new sessions and background jobs. Empty uses the first enabled model.
settingDesc.DEFAULT_USER_ROLE: Default role for newly registered users
settingDesc.DEFERRED_TOOL_SEARCH_LIMIT: Maximum number of results returned by tool search
settingDesc.DEFERRED_TOOL_THRESHOLD: Total tool count threshold above which MCP tools are deferred (0 = always defer)
settingDesc.DIFY_KB_API_KEY: Dify Knowledge API key (Dataset API key, used as Bearer token)
settingDesc.DIFY_KB_BASE_URL: Dify Knowledge API base URL (e.g. https://api.dify.ai/v1 or a self-hosted endpoint)
settingDesc.DIFY_KB_DEFAULT_DATASET_IDS: Default Dify knowledge base retrieval scope for generic agents (fast/search/team) without a persona; persona-bound KBs take priority over this default
settingDesc.DIFY_KB_ENABLED: Enable the Dify knowledge base retrieval built-in tool for persona-bound KB retrieval
settingDesc.DIFY_KB_RERANK_MODEL_ID: Model card ID (kind=rerank) used for cross-KB reranking in Dify KB retrieval
settingDesc.DIFY_KB_RERANK_TOP_K: Final number of segments to return after reranking
settingDesc.DIFY_KB_SCORE_THRESHOLD: Relevance score threshold for Dify retrieval (0.0-1.0)
settingDesc.DIFY_KB_SEARCH_METHOD: Dify retrieval method (hybrid_search / semantic_search / keyword_search / full_text_search)
settingDesc.DIFY_KB_SEMANTIC_WEIGHT: Semantic weight for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, only applies to hybrid_search)
settingDesc.DIFY_KB_TOP_K: Number of segments to retrieve per Dify knowledge base per call
settingDesc.E2B_AUTO_PAUSE: Automatically pause sandbox on timeout instead of killing (preserves filesystem and memory state)
settingDesc.E2B_AUTO_RESUME: Automatically resume paused sandbox on next activity (requires E2B_AUTO_PAUSE)
settingDesc.E2B_TIMEOUT: E2B sandbox timeout in seconds (max 3600 on Hobby, 86400 on Pro)
settingDesc.OPENSANDBOX_DOMAIN: OpenSandbox server address (self-hosted: intranet domain or URL)
settingDesc.OPENSANDBOX_USE_SERVER_PROXY: Access sandbox via server proxy (required for cross-network deployments when backend can't reach sandbox container ports directly)
settingDesc.EMAIL_ENABLED: Enable email service (password reset, email verification)
settingDesc.ENABLE_AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION: Enable audio transcription tool for transcribing audio files
settingDesc.ENABLE_CODE_INTERPRETER: Enable experimental QuickJS code interpreter for agent runs
settingDesc.ENABLE_DOCUMENT_PARSE: Enable the read_document tool: lets non-sandbox agents (Fast/Search/Team) download and parse document attachments (pdf/docx/pptx/xlsx/txt) into Markdown via the internal MinerU service.
settingDesc.ENABLE_DEFERRED_TOOL_LOADING: Enable deferred tool loading for MCP tools (reduces initial context size)
settingDesc.ENABLE_EVENT_MERGER: Enable event merger to reduce event count
settingDesc.ENABLE_IMAGE_GENERATION: Enable image generation tool for agents
settingDesc.ENABLE_LOCAL_FILESYSTEM_FALLBACK: Allow reveal/download flows to fall back to the server's local filesystem when backend download fails
settingDesc.ENABLE_RECOMMEND_QUESTIONS: Enable recommended follow-up question events after each answer (globally controlled by admins)
settingDesc.ENABLE_SANDBOX: Enable sandbox environment for running code
settingDesc.FILE_UPLOAD_MAX_FILES: Maximum number of files per upload
settingDesc.FILE_UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE_AUDIO: Maximum audio file size in MB
settingDesc.FILE_UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE_DOCUMENT: Maximum document file size in MB
settingDesc.FILE_UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE_IMAGE: Maximum image file size in MB
settingDesc.FILE_UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE_VIDEO: Maximum video file size in MB
settingDesc.IMAGE_GENERATION_TIMEOUT: Image generation request timeout in seconds
settingDesc.PHOENIX_API_KEY: Phoenix API key (optional for local Docker)
settingDesc.PHOENIX_COLLECTOR_ENDPOINT: Phoenix OTLP HTTP collector endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:6006/v1/traces)
settingDesc.TRACING_PROVIDER: Tracing backend (none / langsmith / phoenix). Restart required after change.
settingDesc.LLM_MAX_RETRIES: LLM API max retry count (for handling 429 and other errors)
settingDesc.LLM_MODEL_CACHE_SIZE: LLM model instance cache size (~10-30MB per instance). Default 50, supports multi-user/multi-parameter scenarios. Too small causes frequent create/destroy, too large consumes more memory.
settingDesc.LLM_RETRY_DELAY: LLM API retry base wait time in seconds (exponential backoff starting value)
settingDesc.LOCAL_STORAGE_PATH: Local storage path when S3 is not enabled (default: ./uploads)
settingDesc.MCP_GLOBAL_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS: Global MCP cache TTL in seconds
settingDesc.MCP_GLOBAL_MAX_ENTRIES: Maximum entries in global MCP cache
settingDesc.MCP_POOL_MAX_CONNECTIONS: Maximum connections in MCP connection pool
settingDesc.MCP_POOL_TTL_SECONDS: MCP connection pool TTL in seconds
settingDesc.MCP_USER_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES: Maximum entries in per-user MCP cache
settingDesc.MCP_USER_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS: Per-user MCP cache TTL in seconds
settingDesc.MINERU_API_BASE_URL: Internal MinerU FastAPI base URL (e.g. http://localhost:8000). The read_document tool POSTs uploaded document bytes to {base_url}/file_parse for Markdown extraction.
settingDesc.MINERU_API_KEY: Optional Bearer token for the internal MinerU service. Leave empty when the MinerU deployment does not require authentication.
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_APPEND_MAX_DETAILS: Maximum number of appended detail entries kept on project/reference memories before older detail entries are trimmed.
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_AUTO_COMPACT_ENABLED: Enable the background memory compaction agent.
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_AUTO_COMPACT_INTERVAL_SECO: How often the memory compaction agent scans for users over the threshold.
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_AUTO_COMPACT_MIN_INTERVAL_: Minimum seconds between compaction attempts for the same user.
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_AUTO_COMPACT_THRESHOLD: Number of memories per user that triggers automatic compaction.
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_COMPACTION_MODEL_ID: Admin model configuration used by the background memory compaction agent. Leave empty to use the default model.
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_MODEL_ID: Model card ID (kind=embedding) for memory vector search (OpenAI-compatible). Leave empty for text-only mode.
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_INDEX_CACHE_TTL: Memory index cache TTL in seconds (per-user)
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_INDEX_ENABLED: Inject memory index into system prompt for context awareness
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_INLINE_CONTENT_MAX_CHARS: Maximum number of characters to keep inline in MongoDB before offloading the full memory body to the store backend.
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_MAX_TOKENS: Max tokens for memory LLM responses (extraction, consolidation, reranking). Higher values produce longer summaries but cost more.
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_MODEL_ID: Model card ID (kind=chat) used for memory extraction and consolidation. Leave empty to use the default model.
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_PRUNE_THRESHOLD: Days after which never-accessed memories are pruned during consolidation
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_RERANK_MODEL_ID: Model card ID (kind=rerank) for native memory recall reranking. Leave empty to use local reranking.
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_STALENESS_DAYS: Days before a memory is considered stale (shown with warning in recall results)
settingDesc.NATIVE_MEMORY_STORE_NAMESPACE: Base namespace used when storing long native memory bodies in the shared store backend.
settingDesc.OA_SSO_AUTO_PROVISION: Auto-register when OA workcode has no account
settingDesc.OA_SSO_EMAIL_DOMAIN: Email domain for OA auto-provisioned users
settingDesc.OA_SSO_PUBLIC_KEY: OA SSO SM2 public key (130 hex chars)
settingDesc.OA_SSO_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: OA SSO request timeout in seconds
settingDesc.PASSWORD_RESET_EXPIRE_HOURS: Password reset link expiration in hours
settingDesc.S3_CUSTOM_DOMAIN: Custom CDN domain for S3 files
settingDesc.S3_ENABLED: Enable S3-compatible storage for file uploads
settingDesc.S3_ENDPOINT_URL: S3 endpoint URL (required for MinIO and custom providers)
settingDesc.S3_INTERNAL_UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE: Maximum internal upload size in bytes (default: 50MB)
settingDesc.S3_PRESIGNED_URL_EXPIRES: Presigned URL expiration time in seconds (default: 7 days)
settingDesc.S3_PUBLIC_BUCKET: Whether the S3 bucket is publicly readable
settingDesc.SANDBOX_GREP_TIMEOUT: Sandbox grep command timeout in seconds
settingDesc.SANDBOX_IMAGE_DESCRIPTION: Sandbox capability description (admin-authored text injected as-is into the system prompt when sandbox is enabled; empty = no injection). Use it for preinstalled tools, network policy, limits, etc.
settingDesc.SESSION_EVENT_MONGO_BUFFER_MAX: Maximum MongoDB buffer size for session events
settingDesc.SESSION_EVENT_TTL_CACHE_MAX: Maximum TTL cache size for session events
settingDesc.SESSION_SEARCH_BACKFILL_STARTUP_DELAY_SE: Delay before session search backfill starts after server startup, in seconds
settingDesc.SESSION_TITLE_MODEL_ID: Model card ID used for session title and recommendation generation. Empty uses the default model.
settingDesc.SESSION_TITLE_PROMPT: Prompt template for generating session titles. Use {lang} and {message} as placeholders.
settingDesc.SSE_CACHE_TTL: Redis TTL for SSE events in seconds
settingDesc.TASK_BACKEND: Task execution backend. Use arq to enqueue default chat runs through the embedded Redis worker.
settingDesc.TURNSTILE_REQUIRE_ON_PASSWORD_CHANGE: Require Turnstile verification on password change
settingDesc.WELCOME_SUGGESTIONS: Welcome page suggestions displayed to users (multi-language JSON object keyed by language code)
settingDesc.SCHEDULED_TASK_CHAT_TOOL_ENABLED: Allow viewing and managing scheduled tasks in chat
settingDesc.SCHEDULED_TASK_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS: Global concurrency limit for scheduled runs (excess runs wait in queue)
settingDesc.SCHEDULED_TASK_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: Max queue wait for scheduled runs in minutes (skipped on timeout)
settingDesc.KB_ENABLED: Enable the personal knowledge base feature. When off, the sidebar entry is hidden and all knowledge base APIs report the feature as disabled.
settingDesc.KB_EMBEDDING_MODEL_ID: Model card ID used to embed knowledge base content (kind=embedding). Leave empty to reuse the native memory embedding model. Existing knowledge bases need reindexing after the model changes.
settingDesc.KB_RERANK_MODEL_ID: Model card ID used to rerank knowledge base search results (kind=rerank). Leave empty to disable reranking.
settingDesc.KB_WORKER_CONCURRENCY: Concurrency of knowledge base background processing (1-16). Requires a service restart to take effect.
settingDesc.KB_MAX_FILE_MB: Maximum size (MB) of a single file uploaded to a knowledge base.
settingDesc.KB_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE: Number of text chunks sent per embedding request when indexing a knowledge base (1-256).
